RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Seattle operates under a Mayor-Council form of government. The Mayor is elected city-wide. The City Council consists of nine members; seven are elected by district, and two are elected at-large (Positions 8 and 9). While the City Attorney and Municipal Judges are also elected officials, their current names were not explicitly found in the provided search results. There was a slight discrepancy in one search result from January 2024 regarding District 5 and District 2 council members, but the seattle.gov sources were prioritized for current officials.
